name: impair_core_ideas_bench
description: A benchmark focused on assessing models' understanding and application of core mathematical ideas and concepts, intended to probe conceptual reasoning rather than heavy computation. Problems emphasize identifying central principles and using them to derive concise solutions or explanations. Useful for evaluating retrieval-augmented or reasoning-focused math models.
reputation: A niche benchmark within the RAG4Math collection aimed at probing conceptual math understanding; adoption is limited compared to mainstream math benchmarks.
